Posted April 22, 2002

See

Ken Hayes, who was picked up by Canadian immigration last Friday, was released without bail today, after spending a weekend in a detention facility that was much more comfortable than the sewer endured by Steve Kubby and Steve Tuck.

Both Kubby and Tuck are doing much better, recovering from their ordeal.

There has been a tremendous amount of publicity in the Canadian media about this outrage. It was very favorable to us and very critical of the treatment of very seriously ill American refugees.

It is quite possible that legal action will result from these violations of Canadian law by Canadian officials. Canada takes pride in its relatively humane treatment of prisoners. This sort of thing shocks their consciences.

In addition, both Kubby and Tuck have found evidence of lying by the California narks in their desperation to kidnap the two. This will have the effect of further undermining the credibility of DEAland " law enforcement " in Canadian courts.

I am traveling today, but tomorrow I will have a report on the NORML conference, which was the biggest ever.

Also, later in the week, I will be reporting on how the success of the NORML " Bloomberg " ads in New York demonstrates just how badly our media function.
